findings.summary: Evidence report documented pre-fix behaviour and called it correct. Superseded section appended with the re-measured matrix.
Lock redirected non-GET with 307, which preserves the method, so Server Action POSTs re-POSTed to /prelaunch and 404'd. Fixed by using 303 for non-GET/HEAD.
auth branch was a bare fallthrough; a future fourth ProxyPlan variant would silently behave as auth. Added a never-style exhaustiveness assignment.
BR-004 wording claimed days clamp to 00 outside range; pad2 only pads up, so 120 renders as 120. Spec wording corrected, code unchanged.

The 303 fix had no CI regression net — e2e cannot flip the lock flag and src/proxy.ts is outside every coverage glob. Extracted the decision into redirectStatusFor inside src/domain, which the 100% gate owns, and added 7 cases.
BR-004's correction was applied in one bullet but three other restatements still claimed days clamp to 00 outside range. Reconciled all four across both the promoted docs and the plan-dir drafts.
